capabilities.description: Ask a model to synthesize a still image, through the schema.coerce effect a `prompt "…" -> image` raises (DR-0120). Distinct from schema.coerce because generation is not coercion: a different provider, a different unit of cost, and an egress that produces bytes rather than a value. Per modality on purpose — a grant to make stills does not also buy audio, pdf, or video, each of which carries its own <modality>.generate row when its package lands.
